title: RailDSS evaluation export (issue #173; produced by #168)
description: One document per evaluation run: run metadata and one row per scenario and arm with its KPIs. The management KPI view of the web app reads it from web/public/data/evaluation.json. See docs/kpi/evaluation-export.md.

register_version.description: The parameter register version stamp, e.g. 2026.11.1+1618c2a745ca.

scenario_set.description: What was evaluated, e.g. library-v1, nominal-days, real-days.

date.description: The day, for a single-day evaluation.

window.description: The decision-loop window in hours of the day, when the evaluation used one.

seed.description: The seed of the run (the scenario seeds are in the scenario files).

generated_by.description: The command or runner that wrote the file.

sample.description: True for hand-made sample data: the view shows a sample-data banner.

rows.description: One row per scenario and arm; a (scenario, arm) pair appears once (checked by the tests, not by this schema).

scenario.description: A scenario id (SCN-05) or a day label (day 2025-08-20).

title.description: A readable name of the scenario.

arm.description: BL-0 no action, BL-1 greedy controller practice, BL-2 and DSS the DSS with auto-accept (DSS is the name the loop reports use), BL-3 the DSS with a degraded predictor, BL-5 the historical reference.

kpis.description: KPI name to value; null when an arm cannot measure it (BL-5 has no alerts). Names are those of the KPI engine, the conflict KPIs and the alert KPIs.

D1_median_conflict_lead_min.description: Median conflict lead time, min (DSC-05, at least 15).

D2_resolved_before_occurrence_pct.description: Conflicts resolved before occurrence, % (DSC-04, at least 90).

plans_verified.description: Candidate plans that passed gates G0-G3 and plans built in the loop; null for an arm without a loop (BL-0, BL-5).
